candidatas.descricao: High-quality photograph by Liat Portal showing a round challah bread topped with sesame seeds and placed on a white plate. The bread was purchased from a bakery and photographed in a home setting. This image documents challah as a traditional Jewish bread associated with Shabbat and holidays as part of the Foodie Disorder global food culture archive.
